Y76B: O Nanak, emancipation comes only by loving devotional worship; through duality, people are engrossed in duality. ||2||
Deliverance, O Nanak! is in the devotional service of God. Through duality the mortal is engrossed in worldliness.
6G1E: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the swans, the white hairs, come and land upon the pool of the head.
In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend! the white swans (hair) come and land on the pool of head.
GHKE: Youth wears itself out, and old age triumphs, O my merchant friend; as time passes, your days diminish.
The youth wears out, old age wins, and with the passing of days the age continues diminishing, O My merchant friend.

VJNP: At the last moment, you repent-you are so blind!-when the Messenger of Death seizes you and carries you away.
O blind-man! you shall repent at the last moment, when the death's minister seizes and goads you on.
7F8J: You kept all your things for yourself, but in an instant, they are all lost.
Deeming his own, man keeps everything to himself, but in a moment it becomes alien.
WHTS: Your intellect left you, your wisdom departed, and now you repent for the evil deeds you committed.
His intellect has left and his wisdom has departed. He shall repent for the evil deeds committed.
Q0DM: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the third watch of the night, let your consciousness be lovingly focused on God. ||3||
Says Nanak, O mortal! in the third watch lovingly meditate on the Lord.
NY67: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your body grows old and weak.
In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend! man's body grows old and weak.
3YCB: Your eyes go blind, and cannot see, O my merchant friend, and your ears do not hear any words.
His eyes go blind and see not, and his ears hear not the words, O my merchant friend!
R0YS: Your eyes go blind, and your tongue is unable to taste; you live only with the help of others.
With blinded eyes and tongue imperceptible to taste he lives by others might (prop).
ZXM2: With no virtue within, how can you find peace? The self-willed manmukh comes and goes in reincarnation.
How can he, who has no virtue within, obtain peace? An apostate comes and goes.
JH81: When the crop of life has matured, it bends, breaks and perishes; why take pride in that which comes and goes?
When the body-crop matures, it bends, breaks and perished. Why take pride on this body which is subject to coming and going?
J6ZS: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, the Gurmukh recognizes the Word of the Shabad. ||4||
Says, Nanak, in the fourth watch, O mortal! under Guru's instruction, recognise God's Name.
9J50: Your breath comes to its end, O my merchant friend, and your shoulders are weighed down by the tyrant of old age.
The end of your breaths comes, O my merchant friend! and your shoulders are weighed down by the tyrant old age.
E1WL: Not one iota of virtue came into you, O my merchant friend; bound and gagged by evil, you are driven along.
Not even an iota of goodness comes into you, and bound down by evil shall be driven alone, O merchant friend!
G64P: One who departs with virtue and self-discipline is not struck down, and is not consigned to the cycle of birth and death.
He, who departs with virtue sustains not a storke and his coming and going cease.
FSVJ: The Messenger of Death and his trap cannot touch him; through loving devotional worship, he crosses over the ocean of fear.
Death's tarp and myrmidon cannot touch him, and through love and devotion he crosses the ocean of fear.
VWJX: He departs with honor, and merges in intuitive peace and poise; all his pains depart.
He goes with honour, is absorbed in the supreme bliss and all his agonies depart.
397K: Says Nanak, when the mortal becomes Gurmukh, he is saved and honored by the True Lord. ||5||2||
Says, Nanak, through the Guru, the mortal is saved and receives honour from the True Lord.
UG81: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord places you in the womb.
In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend! God put the mortal into the womb.
XAW3: You meditate on the Lord, and chant the Lord's Name, O my merchant friend. You contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
He meditates on God, utters His name and on the Name of Lord God he reflects upon, O merchant friend!
L4H7: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and meditating on it within the fire of the womb, your life is sustained by dwelling on the Naam.
Lord God's Name he repeats and ponders on and in womb fire he sustains life by think of God.
5KT9: You are born and you come out, and your mother and father are delighted to see your face.
He emerges out and is born. The father and mother become delighted to see his face.
ZSXL: Remember the One, O mortal, to whom the child belongs. As Gurmukh, reflect upon Him within your heart.
Remember Him, O mortal! to whom the thing (child) belongs. By Guru's grace embrace God's meditation in your heart.
SE3S: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the first watch of the night, dwell upon the Lord, who shall shower you with His Grace. ||1||
Says Nanak, in the first watch (of night) meditate on God and He will take pity on you, O Man!
T8S7: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the mind is attached to the love of duality.
In the second watch of the night, O merchant friend! the mind is fixed on the duality.
6T1X: Mother and father hug you close in their embrace, claiming, "He is mine, he is mine"; so is the child brought up, O my merchant friend.
Saying, "he is mine, he is mine", he is brought up. The mother and father hug the child to their bosom.
DVRC: Your mother and father constantly hug you close in their embrace; in their minds, they believe that you will provide for them and support them.
The mother and father ever hug him to their bosom. In their mind they know that he will earn and support them.
0PVF: The fool does not know the One who gives; instead, he clings to the gift.
The fool knows not Him who gives (the Giver) and clings to what is given (the gift.)
5A7B: Rare is the Gurmukh who reflects upon, meditates upon, and within his mind, is lovingly attached to the Lord.
Rare is the person who, through the Guru, embraces meditation and fixing his heart and love on God, remembers Him.
EM6Q: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, O mortal, death never devours you. ||2||
Says Nanak, in the second watch, O mortal! him the death never devours.
VVFK: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your mind is entangled in worldly and household affairs.
In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend! man's mind is occupied in the household entanglements.
13WW: You think of wealth, and gather wealth, O my merchant friend, but you do not contemplate the Lord or the Lord's Name.
He thinks, of wealth and gathers wealth, O my merchant friend! but contemplates not over God's Name and God.7
PPPK: You never dwell upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, who will be your only Helper and Support in the end.
He never remembers God's Name and the Lord Master who is to be his Helper in the end.

TJ38: This wealth, property and Maya are false. In the end, you must leave these, and depart in sorrow.
This wealth, property and mammon are false. In the end leaving these, the mortal departs in sorrow.
185Q: Those whom the Lord, in His Mercy, unites with the Guru, reflect upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
They, whom the Lord mercifully unites with the Guru, repeat the Name of Lord God.
C1ZB: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, O mortal, they go, and are united with the Lord. ||3||
Says, Nanak, in the third watch O Mortal! those persons go and unite with the lord.
7X4B: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord announces the time of departure.
In the fourth watch of the night, O merchant friend! God brings about the time of departure.
EL4J: Serve the Perfect True Guru, O my merchant friend; your entire life-night is passing away.
With your hands, serve the perfect True Guru, O my merchant friend! Your whole life-night is passing away.
XREM: Serve the Lord each and every instant-do not delay! You shall become eternal throughout the ages.
Serve you your God every moment, and never make a delay, where by you shall becomes eternal through all the ages.
CKLT: Enjoy ecstasy forever with the Lord, and do away with the pains of birth and death.
With God ever enjoy revelments and do away with the pain of birth and death.
P4P2: Know that there is no difference between the Guru, the True Guru, and your Lord and Master. Meeting with Him, take pleasure in the Lord's devotional service.
Know you no difference between the Exalted Sat Guru and the Lord, by meeting whom Lord's devotional service is endeared to man.
9VAL: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, the life-night of the devotee is fruitful. ||4||1||3||
Says Nanak, in the fourth watch, O Mortal! fruitful is the life night of God's slaves.
E8BZ: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord placed your soul in the womb.
In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend! God placed the soul in the belly.
S6P9: In the tenth month, you were made into a human being, O my merchant friend, and you were given your allotted time to perform good deeds.
In ten months it was make a human being and was given appointed time to practise virtuous deeds.
F2QM: You were given this time to perform good deeds, according to your pre-ordained destiny.
He was allowed respite to do meritorious deeds, as was the primal writ for him.
L3M4: God placed you with your mother, father, brothers, sons and wife.
The mother, father, brother, son and wife, among them the Lord united him.
1GEU: God Himself is the Cause of causes, good and bad-no one has control over these things.
God Himself causes mortal to do evil deeds and good ones, In the power of this being lies nothing.
A1V8: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the first watch of the night, the soul is placed in the womb. ||1||
Says Nanak, in the first watch, O mortal! God cast him in the belly.
PDBU: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the fullness of youth rises in you like waves.
In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend! mortal's full-blooded youth is violently waving.
YAJK: You do not distinguish between good and evil, O my merchant friend-your mind is intoxicated with ego.
Being intoxicated with pride, O my merchant friend! the man distinguishes not between good and bad.
2RLY: Mortal beings do not distinguish between good and evil, and the road ahead is treacherous.
The mortal distinguishes not between good and bad, and the way ahead is arduous.
87SH: They never serve the Perfect True Guru, and the cruel tyrant Death stands over their heads.
He did never serve the perfect True Guru, and over his head stands tyrant death.
5PNH: When the Righteous Judge seizes you and interrogates you, O madman, what answer will you give him then?
When the Righteous judge shall seize and question you, O demented person, what answer shall you, then, give him?
KNR5: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, O mortal, the fullness of youth tosses you about like waves in the storm. ||2||
Says Nanak, in the second watch, the full-bloom youth storm tosses the mortal.
GGZL: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the blind and ignorant person gathers poison.
In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend! the blind, ignorant fellow amasses poison.
3F92: He is entangled in emotional attachment to his wife and sons, O my merchant friend, and deep within him, the waves of greed are rising up.
He is entangled in the love of his sons and wife, O my merchant friend! and in his heart rage the currents of avarice.
74F1: The waves of greed are rising up within him, and he does not remember God.
Within his mind are the waves of greed, and that Lord, the mortal remembers not.
L23N: He does not join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and he suffers in terrible pain through countless incarnations.
He associates not with the saints' congregation and suffers pain in many existences.
GNPZ: He has forgotten the Creator, his Lord and Master, and he does not meditate on Him, even for an instant.
He has forgotten the Creator Lord and fixes not his attention on Him even for a moment.
G57C: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, the blind and ignorant person gathers poison. ||3||
Says Nanak, in the third watch, the blind and ignorant mortal amasses poison.
JTT5: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, that day is drawing near.
In the fourth watch of the night, O merchant friend! that day of death is approaching near.
43KT: As Gurmukh, remember the Naam, O my merchant friend. It shall be your Friend in the Court of the Lord.
Through the Guru remember you the Name of God, O my merchant friend! and it shall be your friend in Lord's Court.
PGKF: As Gurmukh, remember the Naam, O mortal; in the end, it shall be your only companion.
By Guru's instruction, O mortal! think of the Name and it shall be your succourer in the end.8

A2WF: This emotional attachment to Maya shall not go with you; it is false to fall in love with it.
This attachment with mammon shall not go with you. False is to embrace affection for it.
9A0R: The entire night of your life has passed away in darkness; but by serving the True Guru, the Divine Light shall dawn within.
The entire night has passed away in darkness. By performing service of the True Guru Divine light shall dawn on you.
259C: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, that day is drawing near! ||4||
Says Nanak, in the fourth watch, that day your death, O mortal! dawn on you.
T0VE: Receiving the summons from the Lord of the Universe, O my merchant friend, you must arise and depart with the actions you have committed.
On the receiving of the warrant of Lord of the World, O my merchant friend! the man gets up and departs with the deeds committed.
V882: You are not allowed a moment's delay, O my merchant friend; the Messenger of Death seizes you with firm hands.
They allow not a moment's delay, O merchants friend! They seize the mortal with firm hands.
RCWW: Receiving the summons, people are seized and dispatched. The self-willed manmukhs are miserable forever.
On the receipt of the written order, the beings are seized and dispatched. Ever distressed are the perverse person.
QB0U: But those who serve the Perfect True Guru are forever happy in the Court of the Lord.
In Lord's Court, ever comfortable are they, who serve the perfect True Guru.
JDAA: The body is the field of karma in this age; whatever you plant, you shall harvest.
The body is the field of actions in this age. Whatever one sows that he eats (reaps.)
JH3G: Says Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in the Court of the Lord; the self-willed manmukhs wander forever in reincarnation. ||5||1||4||
Says Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in Lord's court, while the self-willed ever wander in transmigration.
GGXT: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, Second House, Chhant:
13GF: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but God. By the True Guru's favour He is attained.
HVBM: How can the ignorant soul-bride obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, while she is in this world of her father's home?
How can the silly bride behold God's sight in her father's home (in this world)?
GEZE: When the Lord Himself grants His Grace, the Gurmukh learns the duties of her Husband's Celestial Home.
When the Lord Master shows His mercy, the Guru ward bride learns the affairs of her Spouse's home, (the next world).
ML5A: The Gurmukh learns the duties of her Husband's Celestial Home; she meditates forever on the Lord, Har, Har.
The pious wife learns the affairs of her Spouse's home and ever meditates on her Lord God.
MQUU: She walks happily among her companions, and in the Lord's Court, she swings her arms joyfully.
She shall then walk happy among her mates and in God's Court shall swing her arm.
ZRBL: Her account is cleared by the Righteous Judge of Dharma, when she chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
By repeating the Name of Lord God, she strikes off the balance of the account of the Righteous Judge.
U54K: The ignorant soul-bride becomes Gurmukh, and gains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, while she is still in her father's house. ||1||
The simple wife beholds the sight of God in her father's home through the Guru.
2H4X: My marriage has been performed, O my father. As Gurmukh, I have found the Lord.
My marriage is performed, O my father! By Guru's instruction I have obtained God.
JWC7: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled. The Guru has revealed the blazing light of spiritual wisdom.
The darkness of my ignorance is removed. The Guru has blazed the very bright light of Divine Knowledge.
5VHR: This spiritual wisdom given by the Guru shines forth, and the darkness has been dispelled. I have found the Priceless Jewel of the Lord.
The Guru-given Divine Knowledge is shedding lustre I have therefore found the priceless gem of God's Name.
AEKC: The sickness of my ego has been dispelled, and my pain is over and done. Through the Guru's Teachings, my identity has consumed my identical identity.
My malady or ego has departed and my anguish is over. Under Guru's instruction I myself have eaten up my self-conceit.
4W6Y: I have obtained my Husband Lord, the Akaal Moorat, the Undying Form. He is Imperishable; He shall never die, and He shall never ever leave.
I have obtained God of immortal form, as my Spouse. He is imperishable and so dies or goes not.
HLHH: My marriage has been performed, O my father. As Gurmukh, I have found the Lord. ||2||
The marriage has been solemnised, O my father! And by Guru's instruction, I have found God.
70E0: The Lord is the Truest of the True, O my father. Meeting with the humble servants of the Lord, the marriage procession looks beautiful.
The truest of the true is my Lord, O my father! by meeting God's Slaves the marriage procession looks beautiful.
DDEN: She who chants the Lord's Name is happy in this world of her father's home, and in the next world of her Husband Lord, she shall be very beautiful.
She, who meditates God, shall be happy in this world and in the next one shall look extremely beauteous.
XJ64: In her Husband Lord's Celestial Home, she shall be most beautiful, if she has remembered the Naam in this world.
In the world to come, she shall be very beautiful, who in this world has remembered the Name.
XKU5: Fruitful are the lives of those who, as Gurmukh, have conquered their minds-they have won the game of life.
Profitable are the entire lives of those, who by Guru's teaching have conquered their minds by throwing the dice of the Name.
1V3C: Joining with the humble Saints of the Lord, my actions bring prosperity, and I have obtained the Lord of Bliss as my Husband.
By meeting the saintly persons of God my affair has prospered, and I have obtained the jovial Lord as my Husband.
NB68: The Lord is the Truest of the True, O my father. Joining with the humble servants of the Lord, the marriage party has been embellished. ||3||
True, True is God, O my father! Accompanied by God's slaves the marriage party gets embellished.9
NFRH: O my father, give me the Name of the Lord God as my wedding gift and dowry.
O my father! give me the Name of Lord, as a gift and dowry.

D2GT: Give me the Lord as my wedding gown, and the Lord as my glory, to accomplish my works.
Grant me God as my raiment, and God as my glory, wherewith my task may be accomplished.
KZ88: Through devotional worship to the Lord, this ceremony is made blissful and beautiful; the Guru, the True Guru, has given this gift.
Through devotion to Lord God the marriage is rendered pleasant. The great True Guru has given me the gift of God's Name.
G96V: Across the continents, and throughout the Universe, the Lord's Glory is pervading. This gift is not diminished by being diffused among all.
In continents and the universe has spread the glory of God. This gift of the Name cannot be confounded with others by confounding.
W69Y: Any other dowry, which the self-willed manmukhs offer for show, is only false egotism and a worthless display.
Any other dowry which the perverse place for show that is false pride and worthless gilding.
3JHX: O my father, please give me the Name of the Lord God as my wedding gift and dowry. ||4||
O My Father! give me the Name of Lord God as a gift and dowry.
NG0K: The Lord, Raam, Raam, is All-pervading, O my father. Meeting her Husband Lord, the soul-bride blossoms forth like the flourishing vine.
The Lord God pervades everywhere, O my father! On meeting with her Spouse, the bride spreads like creeper.
5DBA: In age after age, through all the ages, forever and ever, those who belong to the Guru's Family shall prosper and increase.
The faith and sect of those united with God Guru, is forever set going throughout the two and two ages (four), rather all the ages.
7H3T: Age after age, the Family of the True Guru shall increase. As Gurmukh, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
All the ages through shall run the True Guru's religious lineage which under Guru's instruction, remembers the Name.
57RM: The Almighty Lord never dies or goes away. Whatever He gives, keeps on increasing.
Almighty God never dies or goes. What He gives ever continues increasing.
ATNP: O Nanak, the One Lord is the Saint of Saints. Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the soul-bride is bountiful and beautiful.
Nanak, the one Lord is the saint of saints. By repeating Lord God's Name the bride is adorned.
DA62: The Lord, Raam, Raam, is All-pervading, O my father. Meeting her Husband Lord, the soul-bride blossoms forth like the flourishing vine. ||5||1||
The Lord God pervades everywhere O my father! On meeting with her Spouse the bride extends like a creeper.
C18H: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By the True Guru's favour He is obtained.
4YBR: O dear beloved mind, my friend, reflect upon the Name of the Lord of the Universe.
O my dear friendly soul! do you meditate on the Name of the World -Master.
8WEC: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the Lord shall always be with you.
O mind! my sweet friend, God shall stand by you.
17ER: The Name of the Lord shall be with you as your Helper and Support. Meditate on Him-no one who does so shall ever return empty-handed.
Ponder over God's Name. He shall be an ever-present Helper of yours.(From God's door) none returns empty-handed.
TY4D: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires, by focusing your consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet.
You shall obtain the fruits desired by your heart by fixing your mind on Lord's lotus feet.
JRA3: He is totally pervading the water and the land; He is the Lord of the World-forest. Behold Him in exaltation in each and every heart.
With your sight behold in every heart the Lord of the world-forest, who is fully pervading the ocean and land.
WLBH: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, in the Company of the Holy, burn away your doubts. ||1||
Nanak, gives you a counsel, O my dear soul! burn your scepticism in the society of saints.
43NL: O dear beloved mind, my friend, without the Lord, all outward show is false.
O dear mind! my friend, without God all the ostentation is false.
RK93: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the world is an ocean of poison.
O dear mind! my friend, the world is an ocean of poison.
JE77: Let the Lord's Lotus Feet be your Boat, so that pain and skepticism shall not touch you.
Make the lotus feet of the Creator your boat so that doubt and anguish may not overtake you.
HBMR: Meeting with the Perfect Guru, by great good fortune, meditate on God twenty-four hours a day.
Whom, through the greatest good luck, the Perfect Guru meets; he reflects over the Lord day in and day out.
GS95: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the Lord and Master of His servants. His Name is the Support of His devotees.
From the very beginning and throughout the ages God is the Master of His slaves. His Name is the prop of His saints.
052W: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, without the Lord, all outward show is false. ||2||
Nanak, counsels you, O my dear soul that without God all the show is false.
UCVS: O dear beloved mind, my friend, load the profitable cargo of the Lord's Name.
O my sweet friendly soul! do you occupy the ever stable door of God.
5U13: O dear beloved mind, my friend, enter through the eternal Door of the Lord.
O my darling friendly soul! do you occupy the ever stable door of God.
KWZH: One who serves at the Door of the Imperceptible and Unfathomable Lord, obtains this eternal position.
He who serves at the door of the imperceptible and inscrutable God, obtains the permanent seat.
HHQC: There is no birth or death there, no coming or going; anguish and anxiety are ended.
There is no birth and death there and not any coming and going and mortal's anxiety and anguish end as well.
SL50: The accounts of Chitr and Gupt, the recording scribes of the conscious and the subconscious are torn up, and the Messenger of Death cannot do anything.
The account-paper of the recording angels is torn up and death's couriers become helpless.
DBS2: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, load the profitable cargo of the Lord's Name. ||3||
Nanak, counsels the dear soul to load the cheap cargo of God's Name.
HBKG: O dear beloved mind, my friend, abide in the Society of the Saints.
O my darling friendly soul! abide you in the society of saints.
FCE6: O dear beloved mind, my friend, chanting the Lord's Name, the Divine Light shines within.
O my darling friendly soul! By repeating God's name the Divine light shines.0
6347: Remember your Lord and Master, who is easily obtained, and all desires shall be fulfilled.
By remembering the Lord, of easy access, all the desires are fulfilled.

S4LJ: By my past actions, I have found the Lord, the Greatest Lover. Separated from Him for so long, I am united with Him again.
By virtue of past actions I have attained to the Lover of eminence the Lord. He who was separated from me since long has met me.
LK8N: Inside and out, He is pervading everywhere. Faith in Him has welled up within my mind.
Within my mind I have obtained faith in Him who is pervading everywhere within and without.
HP3B: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, let the Society of the Saints be your dwelling. ||4||
Nanak, counsels you, O my beloved Soul! to secure abode in the saints' congregation.
D761: O dear beloved mind, my friend, let your mind remain absorbed in loving devotion to the Lord.
O mind! my dear friend do you heartily remain absorbed in the lovable service of God.
5HE0: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the fish of the mind lives only when it is immersed in the Water of the Lord.
O my soul! my dear friend, the mind's fish remains alive only by meeting God's water.
1KM1: Drinking in the Lord's Ambrosial Bani, the mind is satisfied, and all pleasures come to abide within.
All the pleasures abide within the mind of those who are satiated by drinking God's ambrosial Gurbani.
JWVD: Attaining the Lord of Excellence, I sing the Songs of Joy. The True Guru, becoming merciful, has fulfilled my desires.
On attaining the Lord of excellence, I sing songs of joy. The True Guru has become merciful and my desires are fulfilled.
G68D: He has attached me to the hem of His robe, and I have obtained the nine treasures. My Lord and Master has bestowed His Name, which is everything to me.
The Guru has attached me to his skirt and I have obtained the nine treasures. The Lord given Name is everything for me.
G0LP: Nanak instructs the Saints to teach, that the mind is imbued with loving devotion to the Lord. ||5||1||2||
Nanak counsels the saints to instruct, so that the soul is sunk in the devotional service of God.
N9BH: Chhants Of Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
J723: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God. Through the True Guru's grace He is obtained.
RMKV: My Beloved Husband Lord is deep within my heart. How can I see Him?
Within my mind is my Beloved How shall I see His sight?
XS8D: In the Sanctuary of the Saints, O Nanak, the Support of the breath of life is found. ||1||
By seeking the sanctuary of the Saint Guru O Nanak! Lord the prop of life is found.
HMW1: To love the Lotus Feet of the Lord-this way of life has come into the minds of His Saints.
The life's routine of bearing affection with Lord's lotus feet has entered the mind of His saints.
KL5D: The love of duality, this evil practice, this bad habit, is not liked by the Lord's slaves.
The evil practice and bad habit of the love of duality, Lord's slaves like not.
375L: It is not pleasing to the Lord's slaves; without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, how can they find peace, even for a moment?
Sans Lord's sight, nothing is pleasing to His attendants without Him. How can they have peace even for a moment?
S74T: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the body and mind are empty; like fish out of water, they die.
Without Lord's Name, the body and mind are empty and die like fish sans water.
SC1W: Please meet with me, O my Beloved-You are the Support of my breath of life. Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing Your Glorious Praises.
Meet me my Beloved. You are the support of my life. Meeting the society of saints I sing Your praises.
BCKS: O Lord and Master of Nanak, please grant Your Grace, and permeate my body, mind and being. ||1||
O Lord of Nanak! show mercy and permeate you this soul, body and heart of mine.
6VL5: He is Beautiful in all places; I do not see any other at all.
Beauteous looks the Lord at all places. I see not any other.
QSJ3: Meeting with the True Guru, O Nanak, the doors are opened wide. ||1||
By meeting the True Guru the shutters are opened, O Nanak!
JMTS: Your Word is Incomparable and Infinite. I contemplate the Word of Your Bani, the Support of the Saints.
O Lord! incomparable and infinite are Your words. They are the mainstay of Your saint. Reflect on Gurbani, O Man!
BF6P: I remember Him in meditation with every breath and morsel of food, with perfect faith. How could I forget Him from my mind?
With perfect faith, at every breath and morsel of mine, I meditate on the Lord. How can I forget Him in my mind?
13G6: How could I forget Him from my mind, even for an instant? He is the Most Worthy; He is my very life!
Why should I mentally forget and put off even for a moment the meritorious Master who is my very life?
KZXZ: My Lord and Master is the Giver of the fruits of the mind's desires. He knows all the useless vanities and pains of the soul.
The Lord gives the heart desired fruits and knows the entire condition of the mind.
0H3R: Meditating on the Patron of lost souls, the Companion of all, your life shall not be lost in the gamble.
By meditating on the Patron of the patron-less and the Comrade of all the life is not wasted away in gamble.
0J10: Nanak offers this prayer to God: Please shower me with Your Mercy, and carry me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
Nanak, supplicates to the Master to mercifully make him swim across the dreadful world-ocean.
TWKV: People bathe in the dust of the feet of the Saints, when the Lord becomes merciful.
When the Lord becomes merciful, man bathes in the dust of the feet of the saints.
585S: I have obtained all things, O Nanak; the Lord is my Wealth and Property. ||1||
Nanak has obtained all the articles as God is his wealth and property.
Y78G: My Lord and Master's Home is beautiful. It is the resting place of His devotees, who live in hopes of attaining it.
Beautiful is Lord's abode. It is the resting place of His slaves, who live in the hope of getting at it.1
UN06: Their minds and bodies are absorbed in meditation on the Name of God; they drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar.
Their mind's and bodies are absorbed in the meditation of the Lord's Name, and they quaff God's elixir.
